independence: No content from the new independent Claude branch read before this conclusion or seal. Conclusion uses preregistered geometry protocol, source XML/rawstatic and frozen prior evidence only.
objective: Does original proportional AB07 pylon L0 require17.579129859mm extra length to reach the encoded/operational ground geometrically, or is physical length independently identified?

conclusions.geometric_reachability_requirement: The extra17.579129859mm is not required for zero-boundary reachability within the unchanged model ranges at the436 screened rawstatic poses. L0 already admits explicit force-sphere primary boundary witnesses with raw knee retained and modestly different ankle angles; no unsupported acceptance tolerance is imposed.
conclusions.exact_raw_tracking: Reaching a boundary with altered joint angles is distinct from preserving exact raw q. At unchanged rawstatic q, L0 force-sphere clearance is positive for436/436 rows; L1 is intersecting for436/436. Neither endpoint is an exact zero-boundary assembly at rawstatic q, and load-bearing force is not evaluated here.
conclusions.physical_subject_length_identification: Available data do not independently establish clinical/hardware necessity or a physically correct AB07 pylon length. The STL dimensions are known model geometry; generic scaled healthy meshes, encoded COP Y=0 and freely calibrated virtual marker positions do not supply measured prosthetic fiducials, shoe/physical support plane, static GRF or clinical fitting dimensions.
conclusions.dynamic_choice: This geometric result cannot select an optimum pylon by GRF matching or prove dynamic equivalence. Root independently executes14 prescribed cases over7 lengths×2 static-calibration offsets with frozen3cycle windows. Their force/recruitment/reserve/tracking evidence is a separate operational screening.

fixed_hardware_pin_relative_dimensions.dimension_limit: Model mesh dimensions relative to the ankle hinge, not independently measured subject hardware/shoe dimensions or closest triangle-surface distance.

L0.reuse_justification: Exact frozen biological/raw knee pose and physical chain. Ankle hinge origin is independent of ankle rotation for zero child offset; marker offsets do not affect joint/body transforms. Sparse native parity independently checks hip/knee/ankle geometry.

L1.reuse_justification: Exact frozen biological/raw knee pose and physical chain. Ankle hinge origin is independent of ankle rotation for zero child offset; marker offsets do not affect joint/body transforms. Sparse native parity independently checks hip/knee/ankle geometry.

limitations: Only the complete rawstatic acquisition is screened geometrically; this is not a new full gait tracking/contact/dynamic qualification.
Finite ankle/knee grids are used to find and rank explicit witnesses. Closest witnesses are among declared knee-grid candidates, not a guaranteed global minimum or clinical feasibility criterion.
Continuous Lipschitz bounds distinguish an always-above surface from an always-intersecting surface. A negative bound with no zero root does not mean impossible contact.
STL, force-contact spheres and detector points differ physically/geometrically and are reported on their own named planes. Sphere zero depth does not carry a specified force.
Encoded COP plane Y=0 is not invalidated; no physical floor height is inferred from marker/mesh minima.

The hardware rotation and range witnesses do not demonstrate acceptable pitch, bilateral clinical balance, sole/shoe alignment, tolerable tracking deviation or correct muscle dynamics. No such acceptance thresholds were measured here.

validation.plugin_hash_acquisition: Hash acquired immediately before native Position FK, after the algebra range screening; no claim it was included in protocol preflight.
